init.title: IoTaWatt options
init.description: Configure how Home Assistant reads your IoTaWatt.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read all sensors, in seconds (5 to 3600, in steps of 5). Power values are averaged over this interval. Shorter intervals give fresher readings but make more requests to the device (4 per poll). For near-real-time power, use live power channels instead.
data_description.lifetime_sensors: Add an energy sensor per power channel that counts up from the start of the device's datalog and never resets. These meter readings suit the Energy dashboard better than the daily totals.
data_description.live_sensors: For near-real-time automations, such as switching on an extractor fan when a hob starts drawing power. Each selected channel gets an extra "Live" sensor with the device's ~1 second average, the value its Status page shows. Each one adds a state change roughly every live interval, so only select the channels you need. Not shown while the device is offline.
data_description.live_interval: How often to read the live power channels, in seconds (1 to 60).
